description: Gear aggregation I (FAM-04): the first half of frmMain CalcCharacterStats, RefreshCharBless, ItemIsUsableByChar, ItemIsCarryActive, ItemIsFlaggedCarried, AccumItemStatBonus, PastedStatIsBuffed
notes: CalcCharacterStats is run from frmMain.frm (scenario key frm) and cut before its 'stealth section; the cut is where P3-18 takes over. The appended lines copy the locals P3-18 needs into the tsProbe control: 0 nEncumPCT, 1 nShadowAC, 2 nWeaponHitMagic, 3 bClassStealth, 4 bRaceStealth.
stat = lblInvenCharStat(0..46).Caption, tags = txtCharStats(0..5).Tag (the stat with bless and gear applied).

Control and global inputs are in each case's forms/globals; combo boxes hold the selected item in ListIndex 0 (cmbEquip, cmbCharBless) or ListIndex 1 with ItemData(1) = the number (class, race). A control array entry that is not listed reads as empty.
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra) to reach branches no stock row has; data holds every row the cases use, for the Rust test.
